correctness.rationale: The substitution recurrence gives exact binary-valuation symbols. Every occurrence of the long prefix has position 2^(n-1)k with t_k=1, proving all return gaps are 2^(n-1) or 2^n. For n>=r+2 the D=2^r coordinate cocycle of each return vanishes except at the last coordinate, where block parity forces one. A bilateral reference point with even-dyadic returns proves each orbit closure has exactly two reference-fibre points and is minimal. Uniform prefix separation makes rank two independent of base point; 2^(D-1) disjoint components therefore exhaust the 2^D-point fibres. All hypotheses, powers-of-two bounds, and limiting coordinate conditions were checked. A separate exact program checked 20106 finite return intervals for r<=4 without substituting computation for proof.

value.rationale: The 2026 primary source only resolves existence of nonminimality for all odd block lengths >=5. The exact component count 2^(2^r-1) and uniform rank two across the natural dyadic subfamily are new structural information about splitting of finite extensions, not a reparameterization of that yes/no criterion. The family includes the smallest unresolved odd length five and all further dyadic lengths, giving an unbounded and sharply quantified decomposition with a simple invariant two-point fibre mechanism.
